item.title: Immigrant labor shortages impacting Louisiana crawfish industry
item.description: Louisiana Agriculture Commissioner Mike Strain says that due to immigration caps only a quarter of crawfish processors have been able to bring in the guest workers that they rely on.

item.title: Bradenton mural festival sparks art revival after state removes pavement paintings
item.description: The Arts Guild of Manatee hosted its first WonderWall Mural Fest in Bradenton Saturday as a way to bring artwork back to a neighborhood after the state ordered pavement art removed last year.

item.title: Oil and gas prices rapidly rise as Iran war shows no signs of letting up
item.description: The price of oil surged higher and showed no signs of halting its rapid climb a week after the U.S. and Israel launched major attacks on Iran that escalated into a war in the Middle East.
